geometry: Axis scale; no shear. Logical CSS px footprint relative to Entity/anchor center. New square TC source, 15 canonical grounds.

units.sampling: One high-quality sample from native alpha-isolated source; subsequent full-pose 1:1 physical blits, integer physical translations and alpha trim with anchor adjustment.
units.limitations: Full authored contact coverage only for listed core classes. Other units and cargo use whole-silhouette motion.

wildlife.directionSystem: Screen-facing directions: 0 E, 1 SE, 2 S, 3 SW, 4 W, 5 NW, 6 N, 7 NE.
wildlife.textureCropping: Runtime RGBA alpha bounds plus 2 logical pixels of padding, copied 1:1 at integer coordinates. Returned anchor equals the full 480×424 ground anchor minus crop origin; the world ground point stays unchanged.
wildlife.walk: Complete A/A/B/B poses sampled directly once.
wildlife.graze: Continuous whole-silhouette inverse warp with premultiplied bilinear sampling; no detached head/limb masks.

scene.sampling: Pixi textures retain physical source dimensions and use ArtSprite.pixelRatio to preserve logical scale. Pixel-aligned sprites avoid subpixel interpolation blur.
